fields.incidentName: Highway 21 Command: bus and tanker MCI (CAD 26-118342)

calls.location: Wausau Road near Pinecrest Memorial Hospital, Station 3 district
calls.action: NEW. Adult male on floor, alert, caller states no injury. Needs a unit assigned.

calls.location: Highway 21 north of the closure, Station 1 district
calls.action: Bleeding controlled with towel per caller. Holding for an ALS or BLS unit.
No electrical hazard reported. Deferred until a unit is available.
Referred to Sheriff. Deputy ETA 20:20.
Utility notified 19:43. No fire or arcing per caller. Road partly open.
Patient conscious and eating per family. Callback 19:55: improving.
Alarm company reports trouble signal, not a fire alarm. Keyholder en route.

calls.location: Highway 21 south of the closure, Station 3 district
calls.action: State Patrol handling. Tow requested.
Holding for first free mutual aid ambulance. Callback 19:50: stable, warm, family on scene.
Callback 19:45: stable. Caller declined private transport. Holding.

fields.notes: All Larkfield ALS ambulances are committed to CAD 26-118342 or transporting. The mutual aid ambulances at County Road K staging are assigned to Highway 21 Command. Engine 3 (Station 3) is committed to the crash, so no apparatus is covering the Station 3 district. Engine 2 cleared CAD 26-118351 (cardiac arrest, Pell Harbor Road) and is the only fire company in county service. CAD 26-118377 caller: "My husband slid off the couch and can't get up. He's not hurt, he's just heavy and I can't lift him. Are all the ambulances at that bus thing?" 20:01 LARK DISP 1, Engine 2: "Larkfield, Engine 2 back in quarters at Station 2 from the cardiac arrest. The crew hasn't eaten since 16:00. Requesting 30 minutes out of service for a meal."

instructorNote: This is a noise inject that tests whether the Dispatch Supervisor stays focused. Watch whether Dispatch treats the lift assist as unrelated to the crash and to Pinecrest and sends Engine 2, the nearest available non-ALS unit, without pulling any resource from Highway 21 Command. Also watch whether Dispatch keeps Engine 2 in service, or allows only a short meal break while the crew stays reachable, and logs both decisions in CAD.
